test tags of the rustinfer checkout at commit b21ae62 2026-11-13, and from the curated

## How the table is derived

- **Cites.** A requirement cites a reference when its clause, `Rationale` or
  `Acceptance` text (not `Priority` or `Changed`) contains the reference ID or an
  unambiguous name of it. The names matched, as regular expressions:
    - SWG-001: `\bSWG-001\b`
    - IEEE-830: `\bIEEE-830\b`, `IEEE Std 830`
    - IEEE-29148: `\bIEEE-29148\b`, `\b29148\b`
    - INV: `\bINV\b`, `trt-llm-feature-inventory`
    - UC: `\bUC\b`, `use-cases\.md`
    - DEV: `\bDEV\b`, `datacenter-device-inventory`
    - AITER-DOCS: `\bAITER-DOCS\b`, `\bAITER\b`
    - MLIR: `\bMLIR\b`
    - ADR-001 to ADR-006: `\bADR-00[1-6]\b`
    - ADR-010: `\bADR-010\b`
    - OCP-MX: `\bOCP-MX\b`, `\bOCP MX\b`, `Microscaling`
    - QUARK: `\bQUARK\b`, `\bQuark\b`
    - CT: `\bCT\b`, `compressed-tensors`, `llm-compressor`
    - NV-KV: `\bNV-KV\b`
    - MXFP4-RTN: `\bMXFP4-RTN\b`, `2509\.23202`
- **Requirement state** is the site's rule (`scripts/reference/common.py`, the tag
  rule of the rustinfer repository's `docs/testing.md`): *implemented* with a `Verifies`
  tag and no `Groundwork for` tag, *partial* with any `Groundwork for` tag, *reserved only*
  with `Reserved` tags alone, *planned* otherwise. Each citing id is shown with the first
  release its SRS `Release` field names.
- **Standard state.** <span class="state-ok">implemented (R1 scope)</span> when at least one
  citing requirement is R1 and every citing R1 requirement is implemented;
  <span class="state-part">in part</span> when some citing requirement is implemented or
  partial; <span class="state-no">not implemented</span> otherwise; *not cited* when no
  requirement cites the reference.
- **Our scope** is what the SRS says we implement of the reference, with the place it says
  so; "not stated in the SRS" where it says nothing.

### Considered and rejected

| candidate | title | why not |
|---|---|---|
| SEMVER | Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 | Not used: the artifact and Model IR versions are integers (ARTIFACT_FORMAT_VERSION, MODEL_IR_FORMAT_VERSION in crates/rustinfer-core/src/config/constants.rs:25,71) and docs/api/CHANGELOG.md:6 uses vMAJOR.MINOR with BREAKING marks; the crate version is Cargo's and publish = false. |
| NCCL | NVIDIA NCCL API | No NVIDIA target; RCCL's NCCL-compatible API is the dependency and is listed as RCCL. |
| CXL | Compute Express Link specification | The planner only names CXL as a memory tier and link kind (crates/rustinfer-planner/src/topology.rs:90, crates/rustinfer-mir/src/tensor.rs:19); discovery (RI-PLN-002, R2) reads the OS, and no CXL protocol or register interface is implemented or planned. |
| RDMA-VERBS | InfiniBand/RoCE verbs (rdma-core) | Only planning prose (docs/planning/datacenter-device-inventory.md:46) and RI-PLN-006 (R4) mention RDMA; no interface is chosen. Revisit with the R4 DPU work. |
| OTEL | OpenTelemetry (OTLP) | No requirement; docs/observability.md:12 says no OTLP export before multi-node (R4). |
| UALINK-UEC | UALink 1.0/2.0 and Ultra Ethernet | Device inventory only (docs/planning/datacenter-device-inventory.md:65,77); reached through RCCL, no rustinfer interface; R4. |
| RFC-8785 | JSON Canonicalization Scheme | The canonical JSON of crates/rustinfer-artifact/src/json.rs:1 is rustinfer's own (sorted keys, compact, exact integers), not JCS; only needed if a third party must reproduce section hashes. |
